senses.gloss:
(उ) जिमु r. 1st cl. (जेमते)
To eat: see जम.

m. (-तः)
1 A cloud.
2 A mountain.
3 A grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
4 A name of INDRA.
5 A nourisher, a sustainer.
6 A plant: see घोषक.
7 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre.
E.
जि to excel or surpass, Uṇādi affix तन्, and मूट् augment, or जी for जीव life, and मूत who urines.

m. (-टः)
A small hill near a mountain.
E.
जीमूत a mountain, and कुट a house.

m. (-नः)
1 INDRA.
2 The author of a celebrated work on inheritance.
E.
जीमूत a cloud, and वाहन vehicle.

m. (-ही)
Smoke.
E.
जीमूत a cloud, and वह to bear, affix णिनि.
